text:
Amanda P.: Heads-up: we're rolling a breaking change to /v2/generate. It's small but will break naive parsers. Need to coordinate SDK partners and marketplace copy.
Devin L.: Can you summarize the exact incompatibility? semver-major?
Amanda P.: Two things: add optional top-level 'response_metadata' and rename 'usage.tokens' -> 'usage.token_count'. We marked it semver-major.
Miguel (AcmeCloud): Our managed connector pins sdk @^2.1.4. ETA? We need to notify customers and schedule our patch.
Devin L.: Rolling timeline: canary in 2 weeks, full rollout in 4 weeks. Proposal: runtime compatibility shim for partner accounts for 90 days, opt-in via header to avoid perf hit for everyone.
Rachel K.: Shim costs cycles — prefer opt-in. Suggest header `X-RDW-compat: legacy` and partner account flag. I'll run perf regressions if we commit to shim.
Devin L.: Agreed. Default strict behavior; enable backward-compat when header present or partner config toggled.
Jessie M.: From comms: partners who want joint marketing need 6 weeks for co-announcement prep. If not, we'll publish a technical deprecation notice and migration guide.
Miguel (AcmeCloud): Can you share a migration snippet so our SDK team can prepare 3.0.0?
Devin L.: Draft snippet for migration: 
```
// old
const text = resp.output?.[0]?.content ?? resp.choices?.[0]?.text
const tokens = resp.usage?.tokens
// new
const newText = resp.output?.[0]?.content ?? resp.response_metadata?.primary_text
const tokenCount = resp.usage?.token_count ?? resp.usage?.tokens
```
We'll add that to SDK changelog and migration guide.
Amanda P.: Marketplace tasks: update listing docs (compatibility note), surface deprecation in listing, and optionally offer early partner canary access.
Devin L.: I'll open PR for the shim and header (ETA 4d) and add changelog + deprecation policy (90-day runtime shim, 180-day full deprecation). Will tag @deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: CI green for compatibility-shim branch (build 4241) :white_check_mark:
Rachel K.: I'll bench shim impact and post canary dashboard next week. Canary plan targets dedicated pools only.
Jessie M.: I'll draft partner email + marketplace copy (ETA 3d). If Miguel confirms joint announcement, push timeline to 6 weeks.
Miguel (AcmeCloud): We'll try to ship SDK 3.0 next week, will confirm by EOD Friday. Thanks for the snippet.
Amanda P.: Action items recap: Devin: shim PR + header. Rachel: perf & canary. Jessie: comms + marketplace copy. Miguel: confirm SDK schedule. I'll draft deprecation notice and loop in Legal for wording.
Amanda P.: @Legal-Team please review the 90/180-day phrasing when I post the draft.
Jessie M.: Noted. I'll coordinate with Miguel before sending any partner-facing joint materials.
